title: Mini player
brief: A compact audio player: art tile, track and artist, a progress bar with times, and previous, play and next buttons. The play button reacts to hover and focus.

inspiration.note: Took the thick rounded progress track with a filled part and a round handle; we used a short fill with a small dot and a cream card.
Took the layout of art on the left and the centred transport controls; art is pure CSS shapes and the palette is ours.
